answer: The GCU demo catalogue includes GCU101 (Introduction to Data Analytics), GCU102 (Academic Communication), and GCU201 (Applied Data Visualisation). Ask about a course by its name or code for prerequisites and assessment details.

GCU101: Introduction to Data Analytics. Learn how to clean tabular data, calculate summary statistics and create basic charts. No prerequisites. Assessment: weekly quizzes 20%, data analysis project 35%, final exam 45%.

GCU102: Academic Communication. Practise academic writing, referencing and oral presentations. No prerequisites. Assessment: annotated bibliography 25%, research essay 45%, oral presentation 30%. There is no final exam.

GCU201: Applied Data Visualisation. Learn to select charts, design dashboards and explain findings. Prerequisite: completion of GCU101. Assessment: dashboard exercises 25%, interactive dashboard project 45%, final portfolio 30%. There is no final exam.

In the GCU demo, open Student Portal > Enrolment, select your term, search for the course, and choose a class with an available place. Check the prerequisites and timetable before submitting. An Enrolled status in My Enrolments confirms your place. If the class is full, select another class or join the waitlist if available. Waitlisted means you do not yet have a confirmed place. Use the term dates shown in the Student Portal to check the demo enrolment deadline.

In the GCU demo, open Learning Portal > My Courses > your course > Weekly Materials for slides and notes. Open Recordings on the course page to find available lecture recordings. Search Library Catalogue for e-books and journals, and sign in with your student account when prompted. For help with writing, referencing or study skills, use Learning Support > Book an Appointment.
